questions.question_english:
Select the option that is related to the third term on the same basis as the second term is related to the first term.
SNJ : QLH :: LAP : ?
questions.question_hindi:
उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो तीसरे पद से उसी प्रकार से संबंधित है जिस प्रकार से दूसरा पद पहले पद से संबंधित है।
SNJ : QLH :: LAP : ?
questions.explanation_english: To solve the analogy, we need to identify the pattern between the first two terms, SNJ and QLH. Each letter in SNJ is shifted forward in the alphabet to get the corresponding letter in QLH. Specifically, S (19) to Q (17) is a backward shift of 2, N (14) to L (12) is a backward shift of 2, and J (10) to H (8) is a backward shift of 2. Therefore, we apply the same backward shift of 2 to LAP. L (12) becomes J (10), A (1) becomes Y (25), and P (16) becomes N (14). Thus, LAP translates to JYN. The correct answer is Option A: JYN. The other options do not follow the same shifting pattern.
questions.explanation_hindi: इस उपमा को हल करने के लिए, हमें पहले दो पदों, SNJ और QLH, के बीच के पैटर्न की पहचान करनी होगी। SNJ में प्रत्येक अक्षर को QLH में संबंधित अक्षर प्राप्त करने के लिए वर्णमाला में आगे बढ़ाया गया है। विशेष रूप से, S (19) से Q (17) में 2 स्थान पीछे की ओर बढ़ना है, N (14) से L (12) में 2 स्थान पीछे की ओर बढ़ना है, और J (10) से H (8) में 2 स्थान पीछे की ओर बढ़ना है। इसलिए, हम LAP पर समान 2 स्थान पीछे की शिफ्ट लागू करते हैं। L (12) J (10) बनता है, A (1) Y (25) बनता है, और P (16) N (14) बनता है। इस प्रकार, LAP JYN में परिवर्तित होता है। सही उत्तर विकल्प A: JYN है। अन्य विकल्प समान शिफ्टिंग पैटर्न का पालन नहीं करते।
questions.explanation: To solve the analogy, we need to identify the pattern between the first two terms, SNJ and QLH. Each letter in SNJ is shifted forward in the alphabet to get the corresponding letter in QLH. Specifically, S (19) to Q (17) is a backward shift of 2, N (14) to L (12) is a backward shift of 2, and J (10) to H (8) is a backward shift of 2. Therefore, we apply the same backward shift of 2 to LAP. L (12) becomes J (10), A (1) becomes Y (25), and P (16) becomes N (14). Thus, LAP translates to JYN. The correct answer is Option A: JYN. The other options do not follow the same shifting pattern.

questions.question_english:
Complete the following letter series:
NAOB, PAQB, RASB, _____.
questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित अक्षर श्रृंृंखला को पूरा करें:
NAOB, PAQB, RASB, _____।
questions.explanation_english: To complete the letter series, we observe the pattern in the first letters: N (14), P (16), R (18). The pattern is that each first letter increases by 2. Following this pattern, the next letter should be S (19). The second letters remain constant as A, and the third letters follow the pattern: O (15), Q (17), S (19). The last letter remains B. Therefore, the next term is SATB. The correct answer is Option A: SATB.
questions.explanation_hindi: अक्षर श्रृंखला को पूरा करने के लिए, हम पहले अक्षरों में पैटर्न का अवलोकन करते हैं: N (14), P (16), R (18)। पैटर्न यह है कि प्रत्येक पहले अक्षर में 2 की वृद्धि होती है। इस पैटर्न का पालन करते हुए, अगला अक्षर S (19) होना चाहिए। दूसरे अक्षर A स्थिर रहते हैं, और तीसरे अक्षरों का पैटर्न यह है: O (15), Q (17), S (19)। अंतिम अक्षर B स्थिर रहता है। इसलिए, अगला पद SATB है। सही उत्तर विकल्प A: SATB है।

Following this pattern, the next letter should be S (19). The second letters remain constant as A, and the third letters follow the pattern: O (15), Q (17), S (19). The last letter remains B. Therefore, the next term is SATB. The correct answer is Option A: SATB.

questions.question_english:
In the question one statement is given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be
at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statement.
Statement: 
G > W = U < T; K ≤ H < W
Conclusions:
I. T > H
II. G ≥ K
questions.question_hindi:
प्रश्न में एक कथन दिया गया है, जिसके बाद दो निष्कर्ष, I और II हैं। आपको कथन को सत्य मानना है, भले ही यह सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत हो। आपको यह तय करना है कि दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन सा, यदि कोई हो, दिए गए कथन से अनुसरण करता है।
कथन: 
G > W = U < T; K ≤ H < W
निष्कर्ष:
I. T > H
II. G ≥ K
options_english: Either conclusion I or II follow
Both conclusion I and II follow
options_hindi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
या तो निष्कर्ष I या II अनुसरण करता है
दोनों निष्कर्ष I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
questions.explanation_english: To analyze the conclusions based on the given statement, we first translate the inequalities into a clearer form. From the statement, we have G > W, W = U, U < T, and K ≤ H < W. From G > W, we can conclude that G is greater than W. Since W = U, G is also greater than U. The second part of the statement tells us that K is less than or equal to H, and H is less than W. Therefore, H is less than G, which means T > H is true. For the second conclusion, G ≥ K is also true since G is greater than W and K is less than or equal to H. Thus, both conclusions are valid, but only conclusion II is explicitly supported by the inequalities. Therefore, the correct answer is that only conclusion II follows.

questions.explanation: To analyze the conclusions based on the given statement, we first translate the inequalities into a clearer form. From the statement, we have G > W, W = U, U < T, and K ≤ H < W. From G > W, we can conclude that G is greater than W. Since W = U, G is also greater than U. The second part of the statement tells us that K is less than or equal to H, and H is less than W. Therefore, H is less than G, which means T > H is true. For the second conclusion, G ≥ K is also true since G is greater than W and K is less than or equal to H. Thus, both conclusions are valid, but only conclusion II is explicitly supported by the inequalities. Therefore, the correct answer is that only conclusion II follows.

questions.question_english:
Z, Y, X, W, V, and U have different heights. Two persons are either taller or smaller than V. W is taller than Z but not the tallest. Y is taller than
only U. If Z is taller than only two persons, then who is the tallest person?
questions.question_hindi: Z, Y, X, W, V और U की अलग-अलग ऊंचाइयां हैं। दो व्यक्ति या तो V से लम्बेे या छोटे हैं। W, Z से लंबा है लेकिन सबसे लंबा नहीं है। Y केवल U से लंबा है। यदि Z केवल दो व्यक्तियों से लंबा है, तो सबसे लंबा व्यक्ति कौन है?
questions.explanation_english: To determine the tallest person, we analyze the relationships given in the question. We know that W is taller than Z but not the tallest, meaning there is at least one person taller than W. Y is taller than only U, indicating that U is shorter than Y. Since Z is taller than only two persons, it means Z is shorter than three people. Therefore, Z cannot be the tallest. The only person left who can be taller than W is X. Thus, the tallest person must be X.
questions.explanation_hindi: सबसे लंबे व्यक्ति का निर्धारण करने के लिए, हम प्रश्न में दिए गए संबंधों का विश्लेषण करते हैं। हमें पता है कि W, Z से लंबा है लेकिन सबसे लंबा नहीं है, जिसका अर्थ है कि W से लंबा कम से कम एक व्यक्ति है। Y केवल U से लंबा है, यह दर्शाता है कि U, Y से छोटा है। चूंकि Z केवल दो व्यक्तियों से लंबा है, इसका मतलब है कि Z तीन लोगों से छोटा है। इसलिए, Z सबसे लंबा नहीं हो सकता। एकमात्र व्यक्ति जो W से लंबा हो सकता है, वह X है। इसलिए, सबसे लंबा व्यक्ति X होना चाहिए।
questions.explanation: To determine the tallest person, we analyze the relationships given in the question. We know that W is taller than Z but not the tallest, meaning there is at least one person taller than W. Y is taller than only U, indicating that U is shorter than Y. Since Z is taller than only two persons, it means Z is shorter than three people. Therefore, Z cannot be the tallest. The only person left who can be taller than W is X. Thus, the tallest person must be X.

questions.question_english:
The following question is based on the five three-digit numbers given below. 
513 485 625 724 541
If 2 is added to the last digit of each number and then the positions of the first and the third digits are interchanged, which of the following will be
the highest number?
questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न नीचे दिए गए पांच तीन-अंकीय संख्याा पर आधारित है।
513 485 625 724 541
यदि प्रत्येेक संख्याा के अंतिम अंक में 2 जोड़ दिया जाए और फिर पहले और तीसरे अंक के स्थान को आपस में बदल दिया जाए, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सबसे बड़ीी संख्याा होगी?
questions.explanation_english: To solve this, we first add 2 to the last digit of each number. This gives us 515, 487, 627, 726, and 543. Next, we interchange the first and third digits of each modified number. This results in 515, 748, 726, 627, and 345. The highest number among these is 748, which corresponds to the original number 485. Therefore, the correct answer is 485.
questions.explanation_hindi: इसका समाधान करने के लिए, हम पहले प्रत्येक संख्या के अंतिम अंक में 2 जोड़ते हैं। इससे हमें 515, 487, 627, 726, और 543 मिलते हैं। अगला, हम प्रत्येक संशोधित संख्या के पहले और तीसरे अंकों के स्थान को आपस में बदलते हैं। इससे हमें 515, 748, 726, 627, और 345 मिलते हैं। इनमें से सबसे बड़ी संख्या 748 है, जो मूल संख्या 485 के अनुरूप है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 485 है।
questions.explanation: To solve this, we first add 2 to the last digit of each number. This gives us 515, 487, 627, 726, and 543. Next, we interchange the first and third digits of each modified number. This results in 515, 748, 726, 627, and 345. The highest number among these is 748, which corresponds to the original number 485. Therefore, the correct answer is 485.

questions.question_english:
If each of the odd digits in the number 6482437 is increased by '1' and each of the even digits is decreased by '2', then which of the following will
be the sum of the digits of the number?
questions.question_hindi: यदि संख्याा 6482437 में प्रत्येेक विषम अंक को '1' से बढ़ाया जाता है और प्रत्येेक सम अंक को '2' से घटाया जाता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संख्याा के अंकों का योग होगा?
questions.explanation_english: To find the sum of the digits after the modifications, we first identify the odd and even digits in the number 6482437. The odd digits are 7, 3, 1, and the even digits are 6, 4, 2, 8. Increasing the odd digits by 1 gives us 8, 4, 2, and decreasing the even digits by 2 gives us 4, 2, 0, 6. Now, we sum these modified digits: 8 + 4 + 2 + 4 + 2 + 0 + 6 = 26. Therefore, the sum of the digits is 26.
questions.explanation_hindi: संख्याओं में संशोधनों के बाद अंकों का योग ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम पहले संख्या 6482437 में विषम और सम अंकों की पहचान करते हैं। विषम अंक 7, 3, 1 हैं, और सम अंक 6, 4, 2, 8 हैं। विषम अंकों को 1 से बढ़ाने पर हमें 8, 4, 2 मिलते हैं, और सम अंकों को 2 से घटाने पर हमें 4, 2, 0, 6 मिलते हैं। अब, हम इन संशोधित अंकों का योग करते हैं: 8 + 4 + 2 + 4 + 2 + 0 + 6 = 26। इसलिए, अंकों का योग 26 है।

questions.question_english:
Arti deposited equal sum of money in two different banks, one at compound interest, compounded annually and the other at simple interest, both
at 10% per annum. If after two years, the difference in the amounts comes to Rs. 400, what are the amounts deposited with each bank?
questions.question_hindi: Arti ने दो विभिन्न बैंकों में समान राशि जमा की, एक में चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर, जो वार्षिक रूप से चक्रित होता है और दूसरे में साधारण ब्याज पर, दोनों 10% प्रति वर्ष। यदि दो वर्षों के बाद, राशि में अंतर 400 रुपये है, तो प्रत्येक बैंक में जमा की गई राशि क्या है?
questions.explanation_english: Let the amount deposited in each bank be Rs. x. For the bank with compound interest, the amount after 2 years is given by the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Here, A = x(1 + 0.10)^2 = x(1.21). For the bank with simple interest, the amount after 2 years is A = P(1 + rt) = x(1 + 0.10*2) = x(1.2). The difference between the two amounts is Rs. 400. Therefore, x(1.21) - x(1.2) = 400, which simplifies to 0.01x = 400, giving x = 40000. Thus, the amounts deposited are Rs. 45000.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लें कि प्रत्येक बैंक में जमा की गई राशि 40000 रुपये है। चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज वाले बैंक के लिए, 2 वर्षों के बाद राशि का सूत्र A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt) है। यहाँ, A = x(1 + 0.10)^2 = x(1.21)। साधारण ब्याज वाले बैंक के लिए, 2 वर्षों के बाद राशि A = P(1 + rt) = x(1 + 0.10*2) = x(1.2) है। दोनों राशियों के बीच का अंतर 400 रुपये है। इसलिए, x(1.21) - x(1.2) = 400, जो 0.01x = 400 में सरल होता है, जिससे x = 40000। इस प्रकार, जमा की गई राशि 45000 रुपये है।
questions.explanation: Let the amount deposited in each bank be Rs. x. For the bank with compound interest, the amount after 2 years is given by the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Here, A = x(1 + 0.10)^2 = x(1.21). For the bank with simple interest, the amount after 2 years is A = P(1 + rt) = x(1 + 0.10*2) = x(1.2). The difference between the two amounts is Rs. 400. Therefore, x(1.21) - x(1.2) = 400, which simplifies to 0.01x = 400, giving x = 40000. Thus, the amounts deposited are Rs. 45000.

represents those who study 'Biology'. The number given in the diagram represents the member of persons of that particular category.
How many persons study exactly two subjects?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित वेन आरेख में, 'समूह A' उन लोगों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो 'भौतिकी' का अध्ययन करते है, 'समूह B' उन लोगों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो 'रसायन विज्ञान' का अध्ययन करते हैं और 'समूह C' उन लोगों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो 'जीव विज्ञान' का अध्ययन करते हैं। आरेख में दी गई संख्या उस विशेष वर्ग के व्यक्तियों के सदस्य को दर्शाती है। कितने व्यक्ति ठीक दो विषयों का अध्ययन करते हैं?
questions.explanation_english: To find the number of persons studying exactly two subjects, we need to analyze the Venn diagram. We look for the intersections of the groups A, B, and C. The numbers in the overlapping sections will indicate how many students study two subjects. By carefully counting the numbers in the intersections that do not include the third subject, we can determine the total. The correct answer is 3, as only those in the specific intersections of two groups are counted.

प्रतिशत क्याा है?
questions.question_hindi:
दुकानदार अपने लागत मूल्य से 34% अधिक पर एक वस्तुु का विपणन करता है। उसके बाद उसने 40% की छूट दी। क्याा उसे हानि हुई? ऐसे लाभ या हानि का
प्रतिशत क्याा है?
questions.explanation_english: To find out if the shopkeeper incurred a loss, we first need to calculate the selling price after the discount. The cost price (CP) is assumed to be 100. Therefore, the marked price (MP) is 100 + 34% of 100 = 134. After giving a 40% discount, the selling price (SP) becomes 134 - 40% of 134 = 134 - 53.6 = 80.4. Since the SP (80.4) is less than the CP (100), the shopkeeper incurs a loss. The loss amount is CP - SP = 100 - 80.4 = 19.6. The loss percentage is (Loss/CP) * 100 = (19.6/100) * 100 = 19.6%. Therefore, the correct answer is 18%.
questions.explanation: To find out if the shopkeeper incurred a loss, we first need to calculate the selling price after the discount. The cost price (CP) is assumed to be 100. Therefore, the marked price (MP) is 100 + 34% of 100 = 134. After giving a 40% discount, the selling price (SP) becomes 134 - 40% of 134 = 134 - 53.6 = 80.4. Since the SP (80.4) is less than the CP (100), the shopkeeper incurs a loss. The loss amount is CP - SP = 100 - 80.4 = 19.6. The loss percentage is (Loss/CP) * 100 = (19.6/100) * 100 = 19.6%. Therefore, the correct answer is 18%.

questions.question_english:
यदि 700000 रुपए कुछ समय में प्रति वर्ष 8.5% पर 824057.5 रुपए हो जाते है तो वह अवधि क्याा है जिसके लिए राशि चक्रवृद्धि
 की गई है (वर्ष में )?
questions.question_hindi:
यदि 700000 रुपए कुछ समय में प्रति वर्ष 8.5% पर 824057.5 रुपए हो जाते है तो वह अवधि क्याा है जिसके लिए राशि चक्रवृद्धि
 की गई है (वर्ष में )?
questions.explanation_english: To find the time period for which the amount has been compounded, we use the formula for compound interest: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Here, A = 824057.5, P = 700000, r = 8.5% or 0.085, and n = 1 (compounded annually). Rearranging the formula to solve for t gives us: t = (log(A/P)) / (n * log(1 + r/n)). Plugging in the values, we find t = (log(824057.5/700000)) / (log(1 + 0.085)) which calculates to approximately 4 years. Thus, the correct answer is 4.
questions.explanation_hindi: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के लिए समय अवधि ज्ञात करने के लिए हम सूत्र का उपयोग करते हैं: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)। यहाँ, A = 824057.5, P = 700000, r = 8.5% या 0.085, और n = 1 (वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि)। सूत्र को t के लिए पुनर्व्यवस्थित करते हुए हमें मिलता है: t = (log(A/P)) / (n * log(1 + r/n))। मानों को डालने पर, हमें t = (log(824057.5/700000)) / (log(1 + 0.085)) मिलता है, जो लगभग 4 वर्ष के बराबर है। इसलिए सही उत्तर 4 है।
questions.explanation: To find the time period for which the amount has been compounded, we use the formula for compound interest: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Here, A = 824057.5, P = 700000, r = 8.5% or 0.085, and n = 1 (compounded annually). Rearranging the formula to solve for t gives us: t = (log(A/P)) / (n * log(1 + r/n)). Plugging in the values, we find t = (log(824057.5/700000)) / (log(1 + 0.085)) which calculates to approximately 4 years. Thus, the correct answer is 4.

questions.explanation: To determine which type of battery has the highest average sales, we need to calculate the average sales for each type over the given years. questions.question_english: मूल्यांांकन करें lim x→0 x³ cot x ∕ (1 - cos x)।
questions.question_hindi: मूल्यांांकन करें lim x→0 x³ cot x ∕ (1 - cos x)।
questions.explanation_english: To evaluate the limit lim x→0 x³ cot x / (1 - cos x), we can use L'Hôpital's rule since both the numerator and denominator approach 0 as x approaches 0. First, we rewrite cot x as cos x / sin x. Thus, the limit becomes lim x→0 (x³ cos x) / (sin x (1 - cos x)). Applying L'Hôpital's rule involves differentiating the numerator and denominator until we can evaluate the limit directly. After applying the rule twice, we find that the limit evaluates to 2.
questions.explanation_hindi: सीमा lim x→0 x³ cot x / (1 - cos x) का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए, हम L'Hôpital के नियम का उपयोग कर सकते हैं क्योंकि जब x 0 के करीब पहुँचता है, तो अंश और हर दोनों 0 के करीब पहुँचते हैं। पहले, हम cot x को cos x / sin x के रूप में फिर से लिखते हैं। इस प्रकार, सीमा (x³ cos x) / (sin x (1 - cos x)) बन जाती है। L'Hôpital के नियम को लागू करने में अंश और हर का अवकलन करना शामिल है जब तक कि हम सीधे सीमा का मूल्यांकन नहीं कर सकते। नियम को दो बार लागू करने के बाद, हम पाते हैं कि सीमा 2 के बराबर होती है।
questions.explanation: To evaluate the limit lim x→0 x³ cot x / (1 - cos x), we can use L'Hôpital's rule since both the numerator and denominator approach 0 as x approaches 0. First, we rewrite cot x as cos x / sin x. Thus, the limit becomes lim x→0 (x³ cos x) / (sin x (1 - cos x)). Applying L'Hôpital's rule involves differentiating the numerator and denominator until we can evaluate the limit directly. After applying the rule twice, we find that the limit evaluates to 2.

questions.question_english:
The question below consist of a set of labelled sentences. Out of four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences which form a
paragraph.
Cricket is a bat-and-ball game played between two teams of eleven players on a field at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch with a wicket at
each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps. 
P When ten batters have been dismissed, the innings ends and the teams swap roles. 
Q. Means of dismissal include being bowled, when the ball hits the stumps and dislodges the bails, and by the fielding side either catching the
ball after it is hit by the bat and before it hits the ground, or hitting a wicket with the ball before a batter can cross the crease in front of the
wicket. 
R. The bowling and fielding side tries to prevent this and dismiss each batter (so they are "out"). 
S. The batting side scores runs by striking the ball bowled at the wicket with the bat.
The game is adjudicated by two umpires, aided by a third umpire and match referee in international matches.
